CONTROL_RESILIENCE.title: Control Resilience
CONTROL_RESILIENCE.description: When a unit is inflicted with a Control status, they gain Resistance to that Control status based on their Resilience. When gaining that Resistance, the value of that Resistance is based on the unit's Control Resilience, while the duration of that Resistance is based on the round duration of the inflicted Control status.

DAZE_RESISTANCE.title: Daze Resistance
DAZE_RESISTANCE.description: When a unit is inflicted with a [Daze] status, they have a chance to resist that status based on their resistance to the status.

MOXIE_DOWN_RESILIENCE.title: Moxie-down Resilience
MOXIE_DOWN_RESILIENCE.description: After a unit gets a decrease in Moxie, they gain Resistance to that effect based on their Resilience. When gaining that Resistance, the value of the Resistance is based on the unit's Moxie-down Resilience; the Resistances are stackable, and these effects are removed after a successful resist.
